events.title: Pill & Chill is in Next Fest!
events.summary: We are excited that the October Next Fest is here and Pill & Chill is participating ahead of the November 17th launch!Tonight we released an update to the demo featuring a much requested tweezer tool for precise sorting, more detailed play stats, and various smaller gameplay improvements.Enjoy Next Fest. It's a fun time to try out a bunch of new demos!

events.title: Demo Update v0.20
events.summary: Thank you for everyone who has played the demo so far! We've gotten some really helpful feedback.Based on some feedback we received this update includes the following changes:Standard Mode has been split into Challenge mode and Chill Mode so players can tailor their play styles. Chill Mode does not contain limiting mechanics allowing for a completely free play style.A "Reset Unsorted" cooldown was added to Challenge Mode.Bug fix when restarting a completed level.Per-level color customization to

events.title: Full Game Releasing on November 17, 2026
events.summary: Pill & Chill officially has a release date of November 17, 2026!Our demo will also be included in the October Next Fest.Don't forget to try out the demo and add to your wishlist to be notified of the release :)

events.title: The Demo is live!
events.summary: The Pill & Chill Demo is now available to play for free!It features multiple hours of gameplay with it's 14 available levels and should give you a good idea of what to expect from the game.Enjoy :)

events.title: Demo Announcement!
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest! We got some really great feedback.I'm excited to announce that the demo will go live on October 8, 2026!If you tried the playtest, the demo will include 10 additional levels, a new wall mechanic, performance improvements, and more.Thank you everyone for all the support!

events.title: Playtest Extended
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has participated in the playtest! The feedback and bug reports have been extremely helpful.I have a lot content planned for the demo, along with performance and gameplay improvements.I had a number of folks ask if the playtest could be left up over the weekend so they would be able to play it. So the new date the playtest will close is 9/7/26!Thank you for all the support!

events.title: Public Playtest is Live!
events.summary: The public beta playtest for Pill & Chill is open from now through 9/4/26! In order to play the game, all you have to do click the "Request Access" button on the Steam store page and you will be granted access automatically.There is a feedback form link on the Main Menu screen of the game. Your feedback is invaluable to the development of the game and I would really appreciate if you could take a couple of minutes to fill that out.Thank you everyone for the support and I hope you enjoy this slic

events.title: 1000 Wishlists!
events.summary: I am really excited and grateful that Pill & Chill reached over 1000 wishlists in less than 2 weeks from the Steam page going live!I was thrilled to see articles from AUTOMATON and 4Gamers written about the game.Thank you everyone who has tested, shared, created content and wishlisted the game. Looking forward to the open beta on Monday where anyone can try it out!

events.title: Open Beta Announcement!
events.summary: We will be hosting an open beta on Steam for our game from 8/31/26 through 9/4/26!Anyone is welcome to play the game during that time. You will be granted access directly from the Steam store page.It will open up at 10:00 AM ET on 8/31/26 and close at 11:59 PM ET on 9/4/26.I hope everyone enjoys trying out the game. events.title: Store Page Launch!
events.summary: We are excited to officially announce our game and make our Steam store page live!Thank you for checking out the game. Soon we will host an open beta and launch a free demo ahead of the full game launch later this year.Stay tuned, announcements to follow :)
